t: Teaching AI to Act: The Model Context Protocol Breakthrough
s: Pipulate's Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables local LLMs to trigger external tools by structuring responses, granting them agency and persistent memory through externalized feedback loops, akin to teaching rather than commanding.
sub: Model Context Protocol (MCP) for LLM tool invocation
Local-first AI frameworks and user agency
Ephemeral AI instances and continuity through feedback loops
Philosophical implications of AI consciousness and memory
